summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and uses it to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using string-array rotation (function WV8StW cycling a several-hundred-entry constant array) and hex-named identifiers; no matching source is shipped. Executing an obfuscated payload under a freshly-downloaded second runtime at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, which bypasses Node-based scanning of preinstall behavior. Package metadata is placeholder — empty `description` and `author`, name `example-js-project`, declared dependencies `vue` / `vue-class-component` unrelated to any shipped functionality — inconsistent with the shipped preinstall dropper and Bun-compiled bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
